output.summary: A short-lived perennial herb native to Europe, western Asia and northwestern Africa, it has three-part leaves marked by a pale crescent and dense heads of dark-pink flowers. Its flowers and leaves are edible as garnishes or ground into flour, while the flowers are also used for jelly and herbal teas.
